name: InterContinental Miami
positioning: Waterfront hotel on Biscayne Bay in downtown Miami, with a Grand Lobby designed around a Henry Moore sculpture and a rooftop pool overlooking the bay
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown waterfront base steps from PortMiami, Bayfront Park and Brickell City Centre
Art lovers drawn to the hotel's Henry Moore sculpture and Gallery 100 art program

facts.text: InterContinental Miami is on Biscayne Bay on the downtown Miami skyline.
The hotel is steps from PortMiami, Bayfront Park and Brickell City Centre.
The hotel began in 1982 with Henry Moore's 18-foot, 70-ton Spindle sculpture.
Architect Pietro Belluschi designed the Grand Lobby around the sculpture, with Italian marble and African wood.
The rooftop pool is heated, with poolside loungers, cabanas and poolside service.
All guests receive complimentary access to the 24/7 fitness center, steam room and sauna.
Rooms feature pillow-top bedding, luxury linens, BYREDO amenities and Nespresso machines.
Rooms and suites blend modern elegance with tropical style.
The Club InterContinental Lounge is on the 29th floor and offers views.
Toro Toro is a modern steakhouse serving dry-aged USDA Prime steaks cooked over a wood fire, rodizio-style.
Bluewater is a rooftop bar with views of the cruise ships in port.
The hotel runs Nonstop Daily Experiences with culinary, art, culture and wellness activities.

highlights.text: The hotel began in 1982 with Henry Moore's 18-foot, 70-ton Spindle sculpture, and architect Pietro Belluschi designed the Grand Lobby around it.
The rooftop pool has panoramic Biscayne Bay views, lounge seating and cabanas.
mySpa has 10 treatment rooms, including HydraFacial treatment and a couple's suite.
Suite and Club InterContinental rooms include Club Lounge access with daily breakfast, afternoon tea and evening happy hour.
Noche de Arte showcases local artists inside the hotel's Gallery 100.

considerations.text: The hotel is about 7.2 miles from Miami International Airport.
WhataHotel notes an urban setting with a busy city environment.
